title: Licoflavone B mitigates allergic rhinitis by restraining epithelial PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB NLRP3 inflammasome signaling.
authors: Shen, Qi; Ma, Xiaoyao; Liu, Hui; Li, Xuemin; Shao, Wenhui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草黄酮LFB缓解过敏性鼻炎的PI3K-AKT/NF-kB/NLRP3信号通路，仅含分子对接但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Allergic rhinitis remains highly prevalent and is often incompletely controlled by current therapies, while accumulating evidence implicates epithelial PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB-mediated activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome in upper-airway inflammation. This study investigated whether the licorice-derived flavonoid Licoflavone B (LFB) alleviates allergic rhinitis by modulating this signaling axis. In an ovalbumin-induced murine model, allergic rhinitis-like symptoms and nasal histopathological changes were evaluated, cytokine levels were quantified by ELISA, and the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome and PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB signaling was assessed by immunoblotting. Unbiased RNA sequencing followed by KEGG and GO enrichment analyses was performed to identify potential upstream pathways. The involvement of PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB signaling was further explored through PI3K-AKT reactivation with IGF-1 and TLR3 stimulation with poly(I) in vivo and in primary human nasal epithelial cells (HNEpCs). Molecular docking was also conducted to explore the potential interaction between LFB and PI3K. LFB reduced sneezing and nasal scratching, partially ameliorated epithelial thickening and inflammatory-cell infiltration, and decreased mast-cell staining. LFB also reduced the levels of IL-1beta, IL-6, IL-5, IL-13, and TNF-alpha, as well as the expression of NLRP3-inflammasome components. RNA-sequencing analysis identified PI3K-AKT signaling as one of the major enriched pathways, and immunoblotting confirmed that LFB decreased the phosphorylation of PI3K, AKT, and p65 without substantially altering their total protein levels. In HNEpCs, IGF-1 restored pathway phosphorylation and partially reinstated cytokine and inflammasome protein expression, thereby attenuating the effects of LFB. Similarly, IGF-1 or poly(I) partially diminished the symptomatic and histological improvements induced by LFB in vivo. Molecular docking positioned LFB within the PI3K catalytic pocket, providing structural plausibility for a potential LFB-PI3K interaction. Collectively, these findings indicate that LFB alleviates ovalbumin-induced allergic rhinitis-like inflammation and is associated with reduced activation of the PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling axis in nasal tissues, HNEpCs, and stimulated mast-cell models. The partial reversal of these effects by IGF-1 or poly(I) further supports the involvement of this signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 过敏性鼻炎（allergic rhinitis）仍高度流行，且常被现有疗法不完全控制，而越来越多的证据表明，上皮细胞中PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB介导的NLRP3炎症小体激活参与上气道炎症。本研究探讨了甘草来源的类黄酮化合物甘草黄酮B（Licoflavone B, LFB）是否通过调节这一信号轴来缓解过敏性鼻炎。在卵清蛋白诱导的小鼠模型中，评估了过敏性鼻炎样症状和鼻组织病理学变化，通过ELISA定量细胞因子水平，并通过免疫印迹评估NLRP3炎症小体及PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB信号的激活。进行了无偏RNA测序，随后进行KEGG和GO富集分析，以识别潜在的上游通路。通过体内IGF-1诱导PI3K-AKT再激活及poly(I)刺激TLR3，并在原代人鼻上皮细胞（HNEpCs）中进一步探讨了PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB信号的参与。还进行了分子对接，以探索LFB与PI3K之间的潜在相互作用。LFB减少了打喷嚏和鼻抓挠，部分改善了上皮增厚和炎症细胞浸润，并降低了肥大细胞染色。LFB还降低了IL-1beta、IL-6、IL-5、IL-13和TNF-alpha的水平，以及NLRP3炎症小体组分的表达。RNA测序分析将PI3K-AKT信号识别为主要富集通路之一，免疫印迹证实LFB降低了PI3K、AKT和p65的磷酸化，而未显著改变其总蛋白水平。在HNEpCs中，IGF-1恢复了通路磷酸化，并部分恢复了细胞因子和炎症小体蛋白表达，从而减弱了LFB的效果。类似地，IGF-1或poly(I)在体内部分削弱了LFB诱导的症状和组织学改善。分子对接将LFB定位在PI3K催化口袋内，为LFB与PI3K的潜在相互作用提供了结构合理性。综合这些发现表明，LFB缓解了卵清蛋白诱导的过敏性鼻炎样炎症，并与鼻组织、HNEpCs及刺激的肥大细胞模型中PI3K-AKT/NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号轴激活的减少相关。IGF-1或poly(I)对这些效应的部分逆转进一步支持了该信号通路的参与。
